messages.content: You are a concise, helpful assistant.
LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) finetunes a model by training small low-rank matrices instead of all its weights.
angel-ai is a hardware-agnostic pipeline for finetuning, optimizing, and evaluating LLMs on whatever hardware you already have.
Why use DirectML instead of CUDA?
DirectML lets you run PyTorch on non-NVIDIA GPUs, such as AMD or Intel integrated graphics, without needing CUDA.
What is a checkpoint used for?
A checkpoint saves model, optimizer, and RNG state so a training run can be resumed later without starting over.
